Badminton.summary: High-speed racquet sport demanding rapid split-step agility, lateral lunging, overhead shoulder mobility, and core stability.
Badminton.warmup_focus: Dynamic lower-body activation, lateral shuffles, shoulder circles, and wrist preparation.
Badminton.recovery_focus: Adductor, hamstring, calf, and cross-body shoulder stretching paired with gentle breathing.

Football.summary: Intermittent field sport emphasizing repeat sprint acceleration, sharp cutting mechanics, hip mobility, and unilateral leg balance.
Football.warmup_focus: Progressive jogging, leg swings, dynamic lunges, hip mobility, and controlled change-of-direction drills.
Football.recovery_focus: Hamstring, hip flexor, groin, and calf stretching with light recovery walking.

Basketball.summary: Explosive court sport requiring vertical jump conditioning, quiet landing mechanics, ankle dorsiflexion, and defensive slide stamina.
Basketball.warmup_focus: Ankle dorsiflexion drills, dynamic lunges, high knees, and defensive lateral shuffles.
Basketball.recovery_focus: Quadriceps, calf, hip flexor stretching, and gentle cooldown walking.

Cricket.summary: Multi-hour skill and conditioning sport requiring rotational core strength, throwing/bowling shoulder mobility, and general endurance.
Cricket.warmup_focus: Arm circles, thoracic rotations, scapular wall slides, dynamic lunges, and light jogging.
Cricket.recovery_focus: Posterior shoulder stretch, chest doorway stretch, hip flexor release, and diaphragmatic breathing.

Tennis.summary: Explosive rotational court sport combining repeated lateral bursts, shoulder endurance, wrist resilience, and split-step timing.
Tennis.warmup_focus: Side shuffles, wrist drills, banded external rotations, leg swings, and light jump-rope rhythm.
Tennis.recovery_focus: Shoulder, triceps, groin, and calf stretching plus paced recovery breathing.

Swimming.summary: Full-body aquatic sport requiring smooth overhead shoulder range, thoracic extension/rotation, and streamlined core control.
Swimming.warmup_focus: Arm circles, controlled shoulder rotations, thoracic open-book drills, and prone Y-T-W activation.
Swimming.recovery_focus: Chest doorway stretch, triceps stretch, gentle cat-cow mobility, and diaphragmatic breathing.

Running.summary: Cyclic endurance sport demanding elastic calf strength, hip mobility, single-leg stability, and consistent aerobic conditioning.
Running.warmup_focus: Light jogging, leg swings, high knees, butt kicks, ankle dorsiflexion, and running A-skips.
Running.recovery_focus: Light walking cooldown followed by calf, hamstring, quad, and hip flexor stretching.

General Fitness.summary: Balanced lifelong wellness approach blending foundational strength, joint mobility, cardiovascular health, stability, and restorative recovery.
General Fitness.warmup_focus: Light jogging or marching, arm circles, leg swings, and dynamic lunges.
General Fitness.recovery_focus: Gentle stretching, cat-cow spinal mobility, and calming diaphragmatic breathing.
